title: Group weighted fine increments by coarse dyadic cells
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Group weighted fine increments by coarse dyadic cells. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Fix a positive horizon and nested regular dyadic grids at levels m and n with m≤n. Assign each coarse cell a real weight and each fine cell a real value. The fine sum weighted by the enclosing coarse cell equals the weighted sum of consecutive differences of the fine prefix sums at coarse grid points.
